def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.rank = [0] * n

    def find_set(self, x):
        if self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.find_set(self.parent[x])
        return self.parent[x]

    def merge(self, a, b):
        a = self.find_set(a)
        b = self.find_set(b)
        if a != b:
            if self.rank[a] < self.rank[b]:
                a, b = b, a
            self.parent[b] = a
            if self.rank[a] == self.rank[b]:
                self.rank[a] += 1

def main():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    if k == 0:
        print(power_mod(n, n - 1, MOD))
        return
    uf = UnionFind(n)
    for i in range(n):
        uf.merge(i, (i * k) % n)
    result = 1
    for i in range(n):
        root = uf.find_set(i)
        if root != i:
            continue
        t = power_mod(k, uf.rank[root], n)
        if t == 1:
            result = (result * n) % MOD
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
